theme_and_archetype.description: Enterprise B2B logistics SaaS and marketing platform. Focuses on authority, extreme clarity, and function-first design. The brand colors (DHL Yellow and Red) are used functionally to guide user action and highlight critical data, rather than for decoration.

usage_rules.primary_yellow: Use for primary CTA backgrounds (ensure text is #333333 for contrast), active states, and structural highlights. NEVER use as a text color.
usage_rules.accent_red: Use sparingly for urgent CTAs, warning states, notifications, and key branded highlights (e.g., inside the logo pill).
usage_rules.contrast_requirement: Always ensure text on #FFCC00 background is dark (#333333 or black). Do not use white text on yellow.
usage_rules.gradients: FORBIDDEN. Stick to flat colors to maintain the high-contrast Swiss aesthetic.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-[#333333] leading-none

typography.pairing_justification: Cabinet Grotesk adds a bold, confident, corporate structure to headings, breaking away from standard SaaS 'slop'. Inter remains as the ultra-legible workhorse for dashboard data and dense text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x default) for marketing; Dense & Structured for Dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.container_paddings: Marketing sections must use py-24 or py-32. Dashboard cards must use p-6.

grid_system.marketing: Asymmetric grids. Avoid perfectly equal 3-column splits where possible; offset them or use Bento-style spans.
grid_system.dashboard: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-6). Use h-full to ensure widgets stretch uniformly.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFCC00] text-[#333333] hover:bg-[#E6B800] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#333333] text-[#333333] hover:bg-[#333333] hover:text-white rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.shape: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to match the Swiss/Logistics grid feel.

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-sm shadow-none. DO NOT use generic drop shadows.
cards.hover_state: For interactive cards: hover:border-[#FFCC00] hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300.

inputs.style: border-2 border-[#E5E7EB] bg-[#F5F5F5] focus:bg-white focus:border-[#FFCC00] focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-4 py-3 text-[#333333]

logo_placeholder.style: flex items-center bg-[#FFCC00] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full font-black tracking-tight text-lg

demo_badge.style: fixed bottom-4 right-4 bg-[#333333]/80 backdrop-blur-sm text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium z-50 pointer-events-none

hero_section.layout: Left-aligned content (60% width), Right-aligned visual (40% width).
hero_section.visual_instruction: DO NOT USE STOCK PHOTOS. Create a custom SVG graphic using Lucide icons (e.g., Map, Package, Plane) connected by dashed SVG lines (stroke-dasharray) and glowing nodes. It should represent a logistics route over Papua New Guinea. Style with stroke-[#FFCC00] and stroke-[#D40511].
hero_section.animation: Staggered reveal for headline, subheadline, and widget using Framer Motion.

features.layout: 3-column grid. Cards with 1px border, white bg. Top of card should feature a large Lucide icon in #D40511.

stats_strip.style: Full width bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white py-16. Use #FFCC00 for the numbers.

auth_screens.layout: Two-column split (desktop). Left side: Centered minimalist form on white. Right side: Branded panel with #FFCC00 background and a large, subtle watermark of the DHL logo text or shipping/parcel motifs (using SVG).
auth_screens.form: Stack inputs with clear, bold labels. 'Remember me' checkbox. Password strength indicator using a horizontal progress bar (colors shifting from #D40511 to #FFCC00 to green).

shell.sidebar: bg-white border-r border-[#E5E7EB]. Text #666666, active item text #D40511 with a #FFCC00 left-border highlight.
shell.header: bg-white border-b border-[#E5E7EB] h-16 sticky top-0 z-40. Contains Logo, Search, Bell, User Dropdown.

kpi_cards.style: White bg, 1px border. Add a subtle 2px top border of #FFCC00 on hover. The value (e.g., '0') should be massive (text-5xl font-black).

quick_actions.layout: 4 big buttons in a grid. They should not look like standard buttons, but rather clickable feature blocks (border, icon on top, bold text below, hover:-translate-y-1).

empty_states.style: Centrally aligned in a large container with py-24. Use an oversized (w-24 h-24) Lucide icon (e.g., PackageOpen, Map, Clock) with stroke-width 1 and stroke-[#666666] or #E5E7EB. Include a bold H3 and a primary CTA.

media_and_icons.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer stroke-width 1.5 or 2 for clarity.
media_and_icons.images: Strictly NO stock photos per requirements. Rely exclusively on pure CSS, Tailwind, and React-based SVG constructions for the hero and auth panels.
media_and_icons.toast: Use 'sonner' for all notifications, styled with square corners and sharp borders to match the Swiss design archetype.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a kebab-case, role-based `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
testing_and_accessibility.focus_states: Ensure keyboard focus is highly visible (focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFCC00] focus:ring-offset-2).

motion_and_interaction.philosophy: Corporate but confident. No bouncy or excessive animations. Sharp, deliberate movements.
motion_and_interaction.hover: Use transform -translate-y-[2px] on cards and primary buttons.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Use framer-motion for simple opacity (0 to 1) and y (10 to 0) transitions on route changes or initial load. Keep duration under 0.4s.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the LOCKED brand colors (#FFCC00, #D40511). Build all visuals (Hero image, empty states) programmatically using SVG and Lucide icons rather than external image assets to avoid stock-photo slop. Implement the 'DEMO MODE' fixed badge on all pages. For the Dashboard layout, ensure the sidebar is collapsible on mobile using shadcn/ui Sheet. For empty states, implement the 'Coming soon' placeholder exactly as specified using gray line-art SVGs.
